name: Pulsedive
description: Pulsedive (pulsedive.com) is a threat-intelligence platform that ingests, enriches and scores indicators (IPs, domains, URLs, hashes), groups them into threats, and curates feeds — with a community free tier and a REST API. This connector pulls indicators from Pulsedive — live via the API (Explore PDQL search `explore.php?q=…` or single-indicator enrichment `info.php?indicator=…`, using a free/community API key in the PULSEDIVE_API_KEY env var) or offline by parsing a saved export (a bulk CSV, an Explore result, or an indicator JSON) — and normalizes each one into a XORCISM threat-intel record (XTHREAT.INTELEXCHANGE): the indicator value + type + Pulsedive risk (unknown/none/low/medium/high/critical/retired), its risk factors, and its linked threats and feeds (threats mapped to actor/malware tags). Feeds the CTI views, the STIX store and ATT&CK coverage. Worker-safe, read-only and licence-safe: it only calls the fixed pulsedive.com API with the operator's own key, or parses an operator-produced export — no Pulsedive code is vendored.

parameters.name: query
parameters.help: Live mode (needs PULSEDIVE_API_KEY): a single indicator to enrich (e.g. 8.8.8.8, evil.com, a URL or hash) via info.php, OR a Pulsedive Explore query in PDQL (e.g. `risk=high and type=ip`, `threat=Emotet`) via explore.php.

parameters.name: file
parameters.help: Offline mode: a saved Pulsedive export to parse instead of calling the API — a bulk CSV export, an Explore result JSON ({results:[…]}), a single indicator JSON (info.php), or an array of indicators.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.help: Maximum number of indicators to import.
